profile.name: GITEGO Faycal
profile.title: Educator | Virtual Assistant | IT Professional
profile.tagline: Software developer and educator who builds practical web applications and helps learners build real programming skills.

about.summary: Software Developer and Educator currently pursuing a Master's in Information Technology at UNILAK, with a Bachelor's Degree in Education with Honours in Mathematics and Computer Science from the University of Rwanda. Trained in full-stack software development with practical skills in Java, PHP, JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, Spring Boot, Python, Flask, MySQL, Git, and modern development tools. Passionate about teaching software development and helping learners build practical programming, web development, database, and problem-solving skills. Combines strong technical knowledge, teaching experience, communication, and learner-centered instruction to support both software development projects and technology education.
strengths: Strong combination of education, communication, and technical expertise.
Practical experience supporting people with different levels of understanding.
Ability to communicate complex information clearly and practically.
Comfortable learning and using new digital technologies.
Team-oriented with a commitment to professional development.

bullets: Supporting students in developing technical skills
Taught Mathematics and ICT to secondary-school learners during school attachment.
Planned and delivered lessons according to learners' needs and curriculum requirements.
Explained technical and mathematical concepts clearly using practical, easy-to-understand examples.
Supported learners with different levels of understanding through individual guidance and classroom activities.
